department: Ministry of Women and Child Development, Government of India
beneficiary: Eligible pregnant women and lactating mothers
benefits: ₹5,000 for the first living child in two instalments, subject to conditions
₹6,000 for the second child if the second child is a girl, subject to conditions
Promotes maternal health, nutrition and health-seeking behaviour
eligibility: Women belonging to specified socially or economically disadvantaged categories

Examples include SC/ST women, women with disability, BPL ration-card holders, PM-JAY beneficiaries, e-Shram card holders, women farmers receiving Kisan Samman Nidhi, MGNREGA job-card holders, women with specified family income and other categories prescribed by the Central Government
required_documents: Pregnancy, childbirth and immunisation records/details as required
application_process: Apply through the prescribed PMMVY process, generally with the Anganwadi Centre or other authorised implementing channel.
source_type: Ministry of Women and Child Development, Government of India
